_comment: Integration windows for 1H NMR end-group analysis of a linear polyolefin.
Copy this file, edit it for your solvent/temperature/field, and pass it with --regions.
The shifts below are the textbook polyethylene assignments; every one of them moves a
little with solvent and temperature, so calibrate against your own spectrum before use.
No chemical shift is hard-coded anywhere in the package: this file is the only source.
Line used to calibrate the ppm axis. The default is the residual protio line of
1,1,2,2-tetrachloroethane-d2, the usual high-temperature solvent for polyolefins
(5.91 ppm). Use 7.26 for CDCl3, 5.32 for CD2Cl2, 7.16 for C6D6.
Set 'ppm' to null to keep the spectrometer's own referencing.
reference.label: residual solvent line

regions.name: main_chain_CH2
regions.note: the (CH2)n envelope, ~1.3 ppm; the intensity reference for everything else

regions.name: CH3
regions.note: saturated chain ends, ~0.9 ppm. Short-chain branches also land here, so on a branched sample this window counts branch methyls too, not just ends

regions.name: vinyl_CH2
regions.note: terminal vinyl -CH=CH2, the two olefinic CH2 protons

regions.name: vinyl_CH
regions.note: the single internal proton of the same vinyl end; upper edge stops short of the residual solvent line at 5.91

regions.name: internal_olefin
regions.note: disubstituted -CH=CH- in the chain: unsaturation that is not a chain end, so it is counted in Mn but not in ends/chain

_comment: chain_count_groups is the assumption that turns integrals into a chain count.
The default says every chain carries exactly one unsaturated terminus, which is what
beta-hydride elimination gives you. A perfectly linear chain then has ends/chain = 2.0
(one saturated end, one unsaturated end) and the departure from 2.0 is the finding.
Mn = repeat_unit_mass * (carbons per chain) + end_group_mass. For CH3-(CH2)n-CH=CH2 the
formula is exactly (CH2)m, so end_group_mass is 0 and the carbon count carries it all.
Shim-quality gate. Height of the trough between the CH3 maximum and the main-chain
maximum, divided by the main-chain maximum. A broad main-chain line lifts the trough
and spills into the CH3 window. max_ratio is empirical: measure spectra you trust and
spectra you know are bad, and put the threshold where it separates them.
One residual solvent line to fit and subtract before integrating an end-group window
it overlaps. fit_windows must exclude the window being protected, or the model will
absorb the signal you are trying to measure.
